About Obby Keyboard Escape

Obby Keyboard Escape is a fast-paced 3D obstacle course game where your keyboard skills are the key to survival! Run, jump, dodge obstacles, and make your way through challenging parkour levels. Watch your timing, avoid dangerous traps, and reach the finish before its too late! Can you master the obstacles, escape the course, and complete every level? Run, jump, dodge, and escape!

How to play

Use WASD to move and press Space to jump Escape from giant robots and complete challenging dungeon levels The game is playable on both PC and mobile devices with touch controls available for mobile players
